column3: The character from the FIRST image is H: keep him EXACTLY the same (bald, white letter H on the forehead, big muscular body, black shorts, olive tactical belt, black wrist wraps), same semi-realistic comic illustration style with detailed shading, NOT flat or 2D. The SECOND image is the exact layout and style to copy: vertical 9:16 Shorts cover, top half dark red #7A1A1A and bottom half teal #0F8B85 split by a torn diagonal paper edge, white label boxes with a thick black outline and a big black number. TOP: H struggling to get up from the floor, one knee down and both hands pushing on the floor, sweating, label box "3". BOTTOM: H rising smoothly from sitting cross-legged to standing with his arms crossed, no hands, confident, label box "10". All text and heads inside the middle 60 percent of the height. No other text.
